title: SvgFeMerge
responsibility: Renders the native feMerge element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeMerge.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet that is rendered with {@render children()} as the content of the feMerge element; when it is omitted, the {#if children} check skips rendering and the element has no content. The component does not validate the snippet or what it renders, so nothing checks the content placed inside feMerge.

outputs.name: SvgFeMerge
outputs.description: The native SVG feMerge element itself (svelte:element with the fixed tag feMerge in the svg namespace), with every prop except children spread onto it as attributes and the children snippet rendered inside it when provided. No wrapper element is added, and the attributes are passed through without validation.
